name: cl-workflow
description: Chooses how much checking a task gets (a software change, a docs pass or research) and starts the planning, review and research agents it needs. Works next to other skill packs and plugins when they are installed.

mode.title: How a session starts: here or away
mode.description: here (default): the agent may ask you with the question tool and plan mode. away: both are refused from the start, the agent takes safe defaults and files the rest, until /cl-workflow:away off. Applies to each new Claude Code process and resumed conversation.
